Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

How far in advance should we book?

+

We recommend booking at least 3–6 months in advance, especially for peak wedding season (October–February). Popular dates fill up quickly, so early booking secures your date.

Do you travel for destination weddings?

+

Absolutely! We cover weddings across Tamil Nadu and all of India. Travel charges apply for destinations outside Chennai. Contact us for a custom quote.

How long until we receive our photos?

+

Edited galleries are delivered within 15–30 days depending on your package. Signature clients receive priority 15-day delivery. Films take 3–4 weeks.

What is your payment structure?

+

We require a 30% advance to confirm your booking. The balance is due one week before the wedding date. We accept UPI, bank transfer, and cash.

Can we customize a package?

+

Yes! Every wedding is unique. We're happy to create a custom package tailored to your specific needs, dates, and budget. WhatsApp us to discuss.

Do you photograph multi-day weddings?

+

Yes, we specialize in multi-day Tamil weddings including Mehendi, Nalangu, and all ceremonies. Multi-day pricing is available in our Signature collection.
